text.tspan: @unhappychoice detonates 292 commits in a single day. Markets rattled.
@unhappychoice patches CircleCI v2 EOL crisis across 2 repos before lunch
@unhappychoice approves 72 PRs in 7 days. Rubber stamp industry in freefall.
@unhappychoice drops mdts v0.21.1 AND gitlogue v0.12.1 in same week. Audacious.
@unhappychoice touches 20+ repos. No codebase left behind. None.
@unhappychoice manually patches faraday across 3 Ruby repos. Dependabot weeps.
@unhappychoice ships gitlogue fix stopping keys from firing twice. Windows users exhale.
